claims.statement: For every g >= 2, the fixed kernel K of the epimorphism pi_1(S_g) -> F_g killing a disjoint cut system gives infinitely generated first-kind uniformising groups in the all-Fuchsian locus of both the reduced surface-based space T_qc^red(X0) and the AIM group-deformation space T_qc(Gamma_0). Along simultaneous pinching to length ell, for all sufficiently small ell, 1/2 < delta(Gamma_ell) < 1 and 0 < 1-delta(Gamma_ell) <= 2 C_g ell, where C_g = g sinh(1)/(pi(g-1)); hence the critical exponent takes infinitely many distinct values. This is an all-Fuchsian strengthening of the broader group-deformation precedent and a direct AIM solution candidate only under the reduced surface-based reading.
dependencies: standard convex-cocompactness fact for finitely generated parabolic-free Fuchsian groups
directlyChecked: lift and descent for the fixed kernel
